dinners.name: THANKSGIVING: Filet Mignon + Lobster Tails, Brown-Butter Cauliflower Mash, Garlic-Butter Mushrooms, Asparagus + Chocolate Espresso Mousse
dinners.note: Holiday splurge. Steak temperatures to preference with food-safety considerations; lobster reaches 145°F. Approximate macros include dessert.

ingredients.item: Filet mignon (raw) — Jake 220 g, Laine 180 g
Lobster tail meat (raw) — Jake 150 g, Laine 120 g
Cauliflower — Jake 220 g, Laine 170 g
Cremini mushrooms — Jake 180 g, Laine 150 g
Asparagus — Jake 160 g, Laine 130 g
Butter — Jake 3.1 tbsp, Laine 2.6 tbsp
Cream cheese — Jake 2.333 tbsp, Laine 1.667 tbsp
Parmesan cheese (grated) — Jake 3.6 tbsp, Laine 2.8 tbsp
Heavy cream — Jake 80 g, Laine 65 g
Dark chocolate 85% — Jake 25 g, Laine 20 g
Coffee espresso brewed — Jake 20 g, Laine 15 g
Sugar-free sweetener (monk fruit) — Jake 4 g, Laine 3 g
Garlic — Jake 2 clove, Laine 1.5 clove

steps: Mousse ahead: melt chocolate gently; cool slightly. Whip half the allocated cream with monk fruit; fold in melted chocolate and cooled espresso. Chill in two ramekins.

Pressure-cook whole cleaned cremini mushrooms with garlic, butter and 60–90 mL water/broth for about 2 minutes at high pressure; quick release per cooker guidance. Reduce liquid uncovered until glossy. Both eat mushrooms.
Steam cauliflower until very soft. Drain thoroughly, mash with cream cheese and Parmesan; finish with browned butter. Roast asparagus at 425°F until tender-crisp.
Sear seasoned filet in hot skillet; butter baste, check center temperature, rest. Broil split lobster tails with butter until opaque and 145°F. Plate together with sides and mousse.

photo.alt: THANKSGIVING: Filet Mignon + Lobster Tails, Brown-Butter Cauliflower Mash, Garlic-Butter Mushrooms, Asparagus + Chocolate Espresso Mousse

stepSections.title: 🍫 Chocolate Espresso Mousse (Make Ahead)
steps: Gently melt the chocolate and allow it to cool until just warm.
Whip the allocated cream with monk fruit sweetener until soft peaks form.
Fold in cooled espresso and melted chocolate, portion into two ramekins, and chill until serving.

stepSections.title: 🍄 Garlic-Butter Pressure-Cooked Mushrooms
steps: Clean the whole cremini mushrooms and mince the garlic.
Add mushrooms, garlic, butter and 60–90 mL water or broth to the pressure cooker.
Cook on high pressure for about 2 minutes, then quick-release following the cooker instructions.
Use sauté mode with the lid off to reduce the liquid until the mushrooms are glossy and coated in garlic butter.

stepSections.title: 🥦 Brown-Butter Cauliflower Mash
steps: Steam cauliflower until very tender, then drain thoroughly so the mash stays thick.
Mash with cream cheese and Parmesan until smooth.
Brown the allocated butter separately over medium heat, watching carefully; fold into the mash and keep warm.

stepSections.title: 🌿 Roasted Asparagus
steps: Trim asparagus and toss with the measured fat, salt and pepper.
Roast at 425°F until tender-crisp, checking after 8–12 minutes depending on thickness.

stepSections.title: 🥩 Filet Mignon
steps: Pat the steaks dry, season generously and heat a heavy skillet until hot.
Sear both sides and baste with butter until the desired internal temperature is reached; use a thermometer.
Rest the steaks before plating.

stepSections.title: 🦞 Butter-Broiled Lobster Tails
steps: Split the top of each shell and gently lift the meat above the shell.
Brush with butter and broil until opaque and the thickest part reaches 145°F; watch closely to avoid overcooking.

stepSections.title: ⏱️ Cooking Order & Plating
steps: Make the mousse ahead and chill. Prepare the cauliflower and clean the mushrooms before starting the hot dishes.
Start the cauliflower mash, then pressure-cook the mushrooms and reduce their butter sauce.
Cook the steaks and rest them while the asparagus roasts and the lobster tails broil.
Plate filet, lobster, mash, mushrooms and asparagus. Serve chilled mousse afterward.

Recipe ingredient amounts shown are per Jake/Laine serving, so multiply both allocations by TWO for four planned servings, then scale by 1.5 for six total servings.

steps: Saturday only: roast poblanos under broiler until charred; cover, peel if desired, seed and dice. Sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft.
